$comment: Agent 7 accounting concept graph seed for Agent 1's Concept/Prerequisite tables. DATA ONLY - no loader (DECISIONS-7.md D-006). Edges are directed prerequisite -> dependent and form a DAG (verified acyclic, see validation block). Field names mirror backend/app/models/learning.py.

ingestion_notes.extraction_method_rationale: Agent 1's Concept.extraction_method must honestly record provenance. These concepts were NOT extracted from a student's uploaded document by an LLM; they were derived by a human-directed research agent from published syllabi and standard accounting pedagogy. Do not label them 'llm' or 'deterministic' - that would misrepresent provenance in a system whose stated design principle is evidence-grounded extraction.
ingestion_notes.student_id_warning: Concept rows are student-owned (student_id NOT NULL). This seed is a TEMPLATE set. Agent 1 must either (a) clone the template per student on enrolment, or (b) introduce a nullable/system student_id for shared canonical concepts. Option (b) changes the uniqueness constraint uq_concept_student_course_name. This is a real design decision, not a detail - see RECOMMENDATIONS.md.
ingestion_notes.confidence_rationale: Confidence is set to 0.9 for concepts whose existence and placement are directly attested by a published syllabus, and 0.75 for concepts that are standard accounting pedagogy but not individually named in the syllabus text retrieved. No concept is given 1.0.
ingestion_notes.approved_flag: All Prerequisite rows should be inserted with approved=false. These are research-proposed edges and should pass through the same expert-review path Agent 1 designed for LLM-extracted edges.
ingestion_notes.evidence_field: Every concept carries an 'evidence' string. Where the evidence is a syllabus course title, that is stated. Where it is a named accounting standard, the standard is cited. Agent 1's schema requires evidence to be non-null.

difficulty_scale.2: Foundational - mechanical application, one concept at a time
difficulty_scale.4: Advanced - integration across topics, standard interpretation

concepts.name: Business Entity Concept
concepts.description: The business is accounted for separately from its owners.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1 Fundamentals of Financial Accounting; IASB Conceptual Framework - reporting entity.

concepts.name: Going Concern Assumption
concepts.description: Financial statements assume the entity will continue operating for the foreseeable future.
concepts.evidence: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements, going concern; IASB Conceptual Framework.

concepts.name: Accrual Basis of Accounting
concepts.description: Effects of transactions are recognised when they occur, not when cash moves.
concepts.evidence: IAS 1; IASB Conceptual Framework - accrual accounting.

concepts.name: Dual Aspect / Double Entry
concepts.description: Every transaction has equal and opposite effects on at least two accounts.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1 Fundamentals of Financial Accounting.

concepts.name: The Accounting Equation
concepts.description: Assets = Liabilities + Equity, and its expanded form including income and expenses.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1 Fundamentals of Financial Accounting.

concepts.name: Debit and Credit Rules
concepts.description: Directional rules for recording increases and decreases by account class.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1 Fundamentals of Financial Accounting.

concepts.name: Journal Entries
concepts.description: Chronological first record of a transaction in debit/credit form.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1 Fundamentals of Financial Accounting.

concepts.name: General Ledger and Posting
concepts.description: Classification of journal entries into individual accounts.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1 Fundamentals of Financial Accounting.

concepts.name: Trial Balance
concepts.description: List of ledger balances used to check arithmetical accuracy of double entry.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1 Fundamentals of Financial Accounting.

concepts.name: Adjusting Entries
concepts.description: Period-end entries for accruals, prepayments, depreciation and provisions.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O1; IAS 1 accrual basis.

concepts.name: Depreciation and Amortisation
concepts.description: Systematic allocation of the depreciable amount of an asset over its useful life.
concepts.evidence: IAS 16 Property, Plant and Equipment; IAS 38 Intangible Assets.

concepts.name: Inventory Valuation
concepts.description: Measurement at the lower of cost and net realisable value; cost formulas FIFO and weighted average.
concepts.evidence: IAS 2 Inventories.

concepts.name: Receivables and Impairment
concepts.description: Recognition of trade receivables and expected credit losses.
concepts.evidence: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments - expected credit loss model.

concepts.name: Bank Reconciliation
concepts.description: Reconciling the cash book to the bank statement.
concepts.evidence: Standard financial accounting curriculum; ICMAP O1.

concepts.name: Preparation of Financial Statements
concepts.description: Statement of financial position, profit or loss and other comprehensive income, changes in equity, cash flows.
concepts.evidence: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements.

concepts.name: Statement of Cash Flows
concepts.description: Operating, investing and financing cash flows; direct and indirect methods.
concepts.evidence: IAS 7 Statement of Cash Flows.

concepts.name: Revenue Recognition
concepts.description: Five-step model for recognising revenue from contracts with customers.
concepts.evidence: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers.

concepts.name: Lease Accounting
concepts.description: Lessee right-of-use asset and lease liability recognition; lessor classification.
concepts.evidence: IFRS 16 Leases.

concepts.name: Financial Instruments
concepts.description: Classification and measurement of financial assets and liabilities.
concepts.evidence: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments. Directly tested in ICMAP model papers: 'IFRS 9 specifies how an entity should classify and measure financial assets, financial liabilities...'

concepts.name: Employee Benefits
concepts.description: Short-term, post-employment, other long-term and termination benefits.
concepts.evidence: IAS 19 Employee Benefits. Directly tested in ICMAP model papers: 'As per IAS 19, which one of the following is not a category of employee benefits?'

concepts.name: Government Grants
concepts.description: Recognition and presentation of grants related to assets and to income.
concepts.evidence: IAS 20 Accounting for Government Grants. Directly tested in ICMAP model papers.

concepts.name: Share-Based Payment
concepts.description: Equity-settled and cash-settled share-based payment transactions.
concepts.evidence: IFRS 2 Share-based Payment. Directly tested in ICMAP model papers: 'IFRS 2 applies to share-based payment transactions in which an entity ___ goods or services.'

concepts.name: Consolidated Financial Statements
concepts.description: Control, goodwill, non-controlling interests, intra-group elimination.
concepts.evidence: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; IFRS 3 Business Combinations.

concepts.name: Sustainability Reporting
concepts.description: General sustainability-related and climate-related financial disclosures.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP S1 'Advanced Financial Accounting & Sustainability Reporting' (new in Study Scheme-2025); ICAP CFAP-03 'Sustainability Reporting and Assurance' (new in Education Scheme 2025); IFRS S1/S2.

concepts.name: Ratio Analysis
concepts.description: Profitability, liquidity, efficiency, gearing and investor ratios.
concepts.evidence: Standard financial statement analysis curriculum; ICMAP M1/M5.

concepts.name: Cost Classification and Behaviour
concepts.description: Fixed, variable, semi-variable, direct, indirect, product and period costs.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O6 Fundamentals of Cost & Management Accounting - syllabus states 'Identify and explain classification of cost and their behaviour'.

concepts.name: Material Costing and Control
concepts.description: Purchase, storage, issue pricing and control of materials.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O6 syllabus - 'Apply material costing and controls'.

concepts.name: Labour Costing and Efficiency
concepts.description: Classification, calculation and evaluation of labour cost and efficiency.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O6 syllabus - 'Classify, calculate and evaluate labour cost and its efficiency'.

concepts.name: Overhead Absorption
concepts.description: Allocation, apportionment and absorption of manufacturing overheads.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O6 syllabus - 'Apply manufacturing overheads costing and controls'.

concepts.name: Absorption vs Marginal Costing
concepts.description: Profit reconciliation between absorption and marginal costing systems.
concepts.evidence: Standard cost accounting curriculum; ICMAP O6.

concepts.name: Job, Batch and Process Costing
concepts.description: Costing methods by production type, including equivalent units and normal/abnormal loss.
concepts.evidence: Standard cost accounting curriculum; ICMAP O6.

concepts.name: Activity-Based Costing
concepts.description: Cost pools and cost drivers as an alternative to volume-based absorption.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M5 Advanced Management Accounting; practice materials reference 'ABC Problems - Activity-Based Costing'.

concepts.name: Cost-Volume-Profit Analysis
concepts.description: Break-even point, margin of safety, contribution and target profit.
concepts.evidence: Standard management accounting curriculum; ICMAP O6/M5.

concepts.name: Budgeting and Budgetary Control
concepts.description: Functional, master, flexible and zero-based budgets.
concepts.evidence: Standard management accounting curriculum; ICMAP M5.

concepts.name: Standard Costing
concepts.description: Setting standards and comparing actual against standard performance.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M5; Studocu ICMAP practice materials 'Variance Analysis Exam Tips: Key Material for Cost Variances'.

concepts.name: Variance Analysis
concepts.description: Material, labour, overhead and sales variances and their interpretation.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M5 Advanced Management Accounting.

concepts.name: Relevant Costing for Decisions
concepts.description: Incremental, opportunity and sunk costs in short-run decisions.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M5; Studocu practice material 'Relevant Costing - Key Materials and Overheads Analysis'.

concepts.name: Throughput Accounting and Bottlenecks
concepts.description: Managing a constrained resource to maximise throughput contribution.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper question: 'Karen Limited has a key resource (bottleneck) of Facility A which is available for 6260 minutes per period.'

concepts.name: Target Costing
concepts.description: Reducing current costs to a market-driven target using value and functional analysis.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper: 'The aim of ___ costing is to reduce current costs by using various tools such as value analysis and functional analysis.'

concepts.name: Life-Cycle Costing
concepts.description: Cost behaviour across product life-cycle stages including learning effects and economies of scale.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper: 'Identify the stage in the product life cycle at which the variable production costs per unit fall further due to economies of scale and learning effects.'

concepts.name: Transfer Pricing
concepts.description: Pricing of internal transfers between divisions and its behavioural effects.
concepts.evidence: Standard strategic management accounting curriculum; ICMAP S6.

concepts.name: Divisional Performance Measurement
concepts.description: ROI, residual income, EVA and balanced scorecard.
concepts.evidence: Standard strategic management accounting curriculum; ICMAP S6.

concepts.name: Time Value of Money
concepts.description: Present value, future value, annuities and perpetuities.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O5 Business Mathematics and Statistics; prerequisite to all investment appraisal.

concepts.name: Net Present Value
concepts.description: Discounting project cash flows at the cost of capital to a single value.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP S5 Strategic Financial Management; referenced directly in ICMAP CBE model papers.

concepts.name: Internal Rate of Return
concepts.description: The discount rate at which a project's NPV equals zero.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper: 'The discount rate that makes net present value (NPV) of all cash flows from a particular project equal to zero is classified as: internal rate of return.'

concepts.name: Cost of Capital and WACC
concepts.description: Cost of equity and debt, and the weighted average cost of capital.
concepts.evidence: Standard corporate finance curriculum; ICMAP S5.

concepts.name: Capital Structure
concepts.description: Gearing, financial risk and theories of optimal capital structure.
concepts.evidence: Standard corporate finance curriculum; ICMAP S5.

concepts.name: Working Capital Management
concepts.description: Management of inventory, receivables, payables and cash, and the operating cycle.
concepts.evidence: Standard financial management curriculum; ICMAP S5.

concepts.name: Financial Risk Management
concepts.description: Interest rate and currency risk, and hedging instruments.
concepts.evidence: Standard strategic financial management curriculum; ICMAP S5.

concepts.name: Business Valuation
concepts.description: Asset, earnings and cash-flow based valuation of a business.
concepts.evidence: Standard strategic financial management curriculum; ICMAP S5.

concepts.name: Objective and Scope of an Audit
concepts.description: Reasonable assurance, the audit opinion, and inherent limitations.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP S4 Audit & Assurance; ISA 200.

concepts.name: Professional Scepticism
concepts.description: A questioning mind, alert to conditions indicating possible misstatement due to error or fraud.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper, verbatim: '___ is an attitude that includes a questioning mind, being alert to conditions which may indicate possible misstatement due to error or fraud, and a critical assessment of audit evidence.' Answer: professional skepticism. ISA 200.

concepts.name: Audit Risk Model
concepts.description: Inherent risk, control risk and detection risk, and their interaction.
concepts.evidence: ISA 315, ISA 330; ICMAP S4 Audit & Assurance.

concepts.name: Materiality
concepts.description: Determining materiality for the financial statements as a whole and performance materiality.
concepts.evidence: ISA 320; ICMAP S4.

concepts.name: Internal Control Systems
concepts.description: Components of internal control and tests of control.
concepts.evidence: ISA 315; ICMAP S4; ICMAP PTM4 Audit Procedures.

concepts.name: Audit Evidence and Procedures
concepts.description: Sufficient appropriate audit evidence and the procedures used to obtain it.
concepts.evidence: ISA 500; ICMAP S4; ICMAP PTM4 Audit Procedures.

concepts.name: The Auditor's Report
concepts.description: Unmodified and modified opinions, key audit matters, emphasis of matter.
concepts.evidence: ISA 700, ISA 705, ISA 706; ICMAP S4.

concepts.name: Tax Residency and Scope of Income
concepts.description: Determining resident status and the scope of taxable income in Pakistan.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M2 Business Taxation; Income Tax Ordinance 2001.

concepts.name: Heads of Income
concepts.description: Salary, property, business, capital gains and other sources.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M2 Business Taxation; Income Tax Ordinance 2001.

concepts.name: Sales Tax
concepts.description: Output tax, input tax, registration and filing under the Sales Tax Act 1990.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M2 Business Taxation; Sales Tax Act 1990.

concepts.name: Withholding Tax Regime
concepts.description: Deduction at source obligations and statements.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M2 Business Taxation; Income Tax Ordinance 2001.

concepts.name: Tax Planning
concepts.description: Lawful arrangement of affairs to minimise tax, and the avoidance/evasion boundary.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP S2 Advance Taxation.

concepts.name: Companies Act 2017
concepts.description: Incorporation, share capital, directors' duties and statutory restrictions.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper: 'As restricted under the provision of section 87 of the Companies Act, 2017, no company shall ... hold any shares in its ___'.

concepts.name: Law of Contract
concepts.description: Offer, acceptance, consideration, capacity and discharge.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O3 Business & Commercial Laws; Contract Act 1872.

concepts.name: Partnership Law
concepts.description: Kinds of partners, reconstitution, and dissolution of a firm.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP Study Scheme 2018 syllabus text: 'Kinds of partners including clauses related to minor partner; Re-constitution of a firm (incoming & outgoing)'. Carried into O3.

concepts.name: Corporate Governance
concepts.description: Board structure, accountability, and the governance code.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP S3 Corporate Laws, Governance & Ethics.

concepts.name: Professional Ethics
concepts.description: Fundamental principles, threats and safeguards; ethical conflict resolution.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP Study Scheme 2018 syllabus text: 'Describe the typical contents of a corporate code of [ethics]. Describe situations where ethical conflicts can arise.' Carried into S3; IESBA Code.

concepts.name: Spreadsheet Modelling
concepts.description: Formulas, lookups, pivot tables and structured model design.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M4 Digital Accounting & Financial Modelling (new in Study Scheme-2025).

concepts.name: Financial Modelling
concepts.description: Three-statement models, drivers, scenarios and sensitivity analysis.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP M4 Digital Accounting & Financial Modelling.

concepts.name: Data Visualisation with Power BI
concepts.description: Data import, modelling and dashboard design for management reporting.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP PTM1 'Data Analytics & Visualisation (Power BI)'.

concepts.name: Generative AI for Business Productivity
concepts.description: Applying generative AI tools to business and accounting workflows.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O2 'Gen. AI & Business Productivity' - one of only two genuinely new courses in Study Scheme-2025.

concepts.name: Business Statistics
concepts.description: Descriptive statistics, probability, sampling and inference.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O5 Business Mathematics and Statistics.

concepts.name: Time Series Analysis
concepts.description: Trend, seasonal, cyclical and random components; forecasting.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper for M5: 'Which of the following are the components of time series?'

concepts.name: Microeconomics
concepts.description: Demand, supply, elasticity, market structures and firm behaviour.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O4 Business Economics.

concepts.name: Macroeconomics
concepts.description: National income, inflation, monetary and fiscal policy.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP O4 Business Economics.

concepts.name: Strategic Analysis
concepts.description: Environmental analysis using PESTEL, Porter's Five Forces and value chain.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP PTM6 Strategic Management Analysis; S6 Strategic Management Accounting.

concepts.name: Strategic Intelligence and Sensing
concepts.description: Analysing information for implications to create strategic intelligence.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper: '___ is the method for analyzing the information for implications, while creating strategic intelligence.'

concepts.name: Resource and Competence Audit
concepts.description: Adequacy and suitability of resources and competences necessary for future success.
concepts.evidence: ICMAP CBE model paper: 'The adequacy and suitability of the resources and competences the organization has, and which are necessary for its future success, is called ___'.

IFRS 15 application presumes the statement framework.

validation.dag_verification_method: Depth-first cycle detection over all 89 ingestible edges: zero cycles found. All edge endpoints resolve to declared concept ids except the one deliberate placeholder noted below. Agent 1 MUST still re-verify with NetworkX before insert, as required by its own online cycle-rejection design.
known_issues: One placeholder row with id 'acc.tvm_placeholder' and confidence 0.0 is present in the prerequisites array as an explicit marker that an earlier draft edge was superseded by 'fin.tvm -> acc.leases'. It references a concept that does not exist and MUST be dropped on ingestion. It is left visible rather than deleted silently so the correction is auditable.

Five edges are marked 'Weak edge - review' with confidence 0.6-0.65. These are cross-domain associations rather than strict prerequisites and should be rejected by default unless an expert approves them.

Cross-body course_keys (ACCA, ICAP) are indicative mappings of where a concept appears, not claims of syllabus equivalence. ICMAP mappings are the best-evidenced; ACCA and ICAP mappings are lower confidence.

'dig.genai' (Gen. AI & Business Productivity, ICMAP O2) is an ISOLATED node with no prerequisites and no dependents. This is not an oversight: it is a genuinely standalone new course with no pedagogical dependency on any other accounting concept, which is itself a finding about how ICMAP bolted it on. Agent 1's UI must handle isolated nodes rather than assuming every concept is reachable from a root.

16 concepts are roots (no prerequisites). A student's true entry point depends on their entry qualification, not on the graph - a 16-year-degree entrant starts at ML-2 and should not be shown O-level roots as 'next'.
coverage_gaps: Islamic finance and AAOIFI-based accounting: no concepts seeded. Material for Pakistan - see pakistan/ISLAMIC_FINANCE.md.
Public sector / government accounting: no concepts seeded.

ICMAP M3 Organizational Management and PTM2/PTM3 (entrepreneurship, communication, behavioural skills): thinly covered. These are non-technical and do not decompose into a prerequisite DAG as cleanly.
